# Trowser — Copilot instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. It has the build and test commands, the rules every change must follow, and how to verify a change on the built app. [ARCHITECTURE.md](../ARCHITECTURE.md) maps the code and has recipes for common changes.

To drive a running Trowser as a browser (MCP, REST, scripts) rather than change its code, see [trowserkit/trowser.mdc](../trowserkit/trowser.mdc) and [trowserkit/trowser-api-reference.md](../trowserkit/trowser-api-reference.md).
